items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: WebUI-form and daemon-form entries listed with same fields; both countersign exactly once; contract doc + pinned fixture + sha gate.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Daemon entry without a Lead bullet is not listed (documented); unparseable block still throws in toLoggedBlock.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Quote/evidence injection closed: headers inside a fence ignored, lead = first bullet after closing fence; tests for forged header, forged Lead in quote and evidence.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Real files and real countersign core; mixed doc, retry, crash residue, CRLF, orphan marker, client parse of the same pinned fixture.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Single pass per parse; indexOf per fence is O(lines) worst case on small files.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New module proposed-entry-format.ts (<300 lines); decisions-lock re-exports; client mirror stays under limit.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer = leadwright renderEntry, consumers = server parser + client mirror; probed with the pinned sample, CRLF and adversarial inputs.
